records.measurement_scope: One shared two-setter authoring session, including specification construction, failures, timeouts, development compilation and reporting. Reference once in aggregate; no per-case or per-problem allocation. Final raw metrics are in the closed shared run.
records.unobserved_reason: No separate per-case/problem boundaries. One command059 collision also lost original GNU timing, so complete historical tool CPU/peak cannot be reconstructed; raw surviving resources are retained as a measured subset.
